tom-majich.text: Speaking for Kinneloa Irrigation District after the Eaton Fire, Majich warned contractors against taking water without permits: water systems "are owned by you and that water theft is theft of your property," and "also a public health risk."

source.title: Pasadena Now: Altadena Water Agencies Report Progress Toward Drinking Water Restoration (2025)

john-vrsalovich.text: On June 22, 2026, Vrsalovich voted with the unanimous board to adopt the district's proposed budget, rates, charges and reserves and modify its reserve policy.

source.title: Foothill MWD July 2026 special board packet (minutes of June 22, 2026 regular meeting)

john-vrsalovich.text: On July 30, 2026, Vrsalovich moved, and the board approved, advertising a request for proposals for a condition and seismic assessment of the La Cañada East and La Crescenta East and West reservoirs.

source.title: Foothill MWD August 2026 board packet (minutes of July 30, 2026 special meeting)

notes: Incumbent Vrsalovich: only routine recorded board votes found (all 2026 votes in the minutes reviewed were unanimous except a July 30 AB 1383 pension-bill item, whose motion wording isn't recorded, so it was omitted). Majich (Kinneloa Irrigation District manager): no campaign site or 2026 statements found; one 2025 professional statement. Searches used: 4
